description:
Search the full satellite catalog by name, alias or NORAD number, best match first, to turn a name like "SDO" or "NOAA 19" into a NORAD number for the other tools (they resolve a name outside the popular list only on an exact whole-name match). For the popular satellites use list_satellites; for one satellite's facts and TLE use get_satellite.

Matching order: an exact NORAD number, the whole name, the start of the name or of a word, part of the number, anywhere in the name, then near misses, so a small typo still finds it. To find satellites by downlink kind, use mode "radio" with the kind as the query (query "sstv"). No match is an empty list. Reads only SeekSat's catalog. Read-only, free, no key needed; up to 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP address. A bad input or a failure comes back as an error result (isError) whose text names the problem and what to change.

limit.description: how many results to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.

mode.description: "visual" (default): best name match first; "radio": satellites with known radio downlinks first among equally good matches. To list satellites with a kind of downlink, set mode "radio" and put the kind in query (e.g. query "sstv"); mode itself takes only "visual" or "radio".

query.description: a name, part of one, or a NORAD number, e.g. "sdo", "noaa 19", "25544". With mode "radio", a downlink kind as the whole query (e.g. "sstv", "aprs", "cw") lists satellites that have one.

name: search_satellites

results.description: best match first; empty when nothing matches

hasKnownDownlinks.description: true when it has known radio downlinks

title: Search satellites
